slice: fixed-host reconcile of the residual round-7 core-validation Goal
purpose: One reconcile call against the residual inert round-7 core-validation Goal: read-only classification, exactly one cancel for the inert unauthorized Goal, no Goal creation, no model call and no retry; then verify the live data invariants and the diagnostics cache.

reload.classification: normal startup writes; the residual Goal stays unauthorized/paused/cancelled=false; no business facts changed.

reconcile.classification: exactly +1 commitSeq for the single cancel transition; no events/deliveries, no new/removed sessions or Goals, no Task/Effect/budget change and no artifact; the runtime-state file is unchanged.

postStatus.classification: the final status call is read-only (no commitSeq/event/session/state change) and caches the reconcile receipt.

cachedReceipt.fieldsPresent: classification/readback/observed/evidence/stopAction/cancelAttempts/postCancel/unknowns (the diagnostics cache stores the validated reconcile core receipt; readOnly/createsGoal/modelCalls/retries are declared on the tool response and committed in the receipt file, not in this cache entry)

invariants: no new Goal/Task/Effect/budget/Session/artifact; no model request; only the inert Goal was cancelled (version 2, cancelled=true, paused=true); all previously known Session files byte-identical; runtime-state file unchanged.
findings: The residual Goal was classified inert-unauthorized exactly as expected and received exactly one cancel with no retry; the post-cancel readback reports cancelled=true/paused=true/version=2.
The live data invariant holds: +1 commitSeq only, no events/deliveries, no new/removed sessions or Goals, no Task/Effect/budget/artifact, state file unchanged.

The diagnostics cache contains the validated reconcile core receipt (classification/readback/observed/evidence/stopAction/cancelAttempts/postCancel/unknowns); readOnly=true, createsGoal=false, modelCalls=0 and retries=0 are declared on the tool response and committed in the receipt file, not stored in this cache entry.
The underlying create failure cause is still not fixed: a future bounded validation attempt would need a new frozen plan and must not reuse the failed create; this round only reconciled the residual.
limitations: This proves the reconcile/cancel path only; it does not prove the bounded real core Goal business chain and does not fix the original create failure.
No model/embedding/Task/worker/Goal completion is involved; the residual Goal Session remains as history.
A future create attempt would require a new explicit owner decision and a newly frozen plan.
